title: Shubh Shakti Yojana Form: Rajasthan BOCW Rs 55,000 Guide
meta_description: Shubh Shakti Yojana gives Rs 55,000 to daughters of registered BOCW workers in Rajasthan. Download form and apply at labour.rajasthan.gov.in.

hero.one_liner: Shubh Shakti Yojana gives Rs 55,000 one-time to unmarried daughters of registered Rajasthan BOCW construction workers. Download the form and apply online.

what_is_it: Shubh Shakti Yojana is a welfare scheme run by the Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Board under the state Labour Department. The scheme was launched to reduce the financial burden on families of registered construction workers and to prevent the treatment of daughters as liabilities.

The name 'Shubh Shakti' means auspicious strength. The scheme recognises the value of girls in construction worker families and provides a meaningful financial grant to support their future, whether through education, employment, or marriage.

how_to_apply.title: Confirm that the BOCW registration is at least 1 year old
how_to_apply.description: The woman worker or the parent of the applying daughter must have been a registered beneficiary of the Rajasthan BOCW board for at least 1 year before applying. The registered worker must also have worked a minimum of 90 days in the preceding year. Both conditions must be met before submitting the application.

how_to_apply.title: Download the Shubh Shakti Yojana application form
how_to_apply.description: Download the official application form from the Rajasthan Labour Department website at labour.rajasthan.gov.in. The form is available in the scheme documents section. Fill in the form in Hindi or English with the details of the registered worker and the beneficiary daughter or woman worker.

how_to_apply.title: Gather all required documents
how_to_apply.description: Collect the following documents: permanent address certificate, age proof confirming the girl is at least 18 years old, Class 8 pass certificate or mark sheet, income certificate of the registered worker family, certificate of non-income tax status, BPL card (if applicable), caste certificate, copy of the bank passbook in the girl's name showing account number and IFSC code, and two passport-size photographs. Aadhaar card is optional but recommended.

how_to_apply.title: Attach the introduction letter about the girl
how_to_apply.description: An introduction letter about the beneficiary girl is required along with the application form. This letter confirms the identity and relationship of the girl to the registered BOCW worker and is submitted as part of the application package.

how_to_apply.title: Submit the form to the local Labour Department office
how_to_apply.description: Submit the filled form and all documents to the local Labour Department office or to the official authorised by the Divisional Secretary. Online submission is also available through the official Rajasthan Labour Department portal at labour.rajasthan.gov.in for registered BOCW workers.

how_to_apply.title: Await verification and disbursement
how_to_apply.description: The application is verified by a Tahsildar or gazette officer to confirm the worker's BOCW registration status. The verification and approval process takes up to 60 days after submission. Once approved, the Rs 55,000 amount is transferred directly to the girl's bank account through DBT.

how_to_apply.title: Check application status on Jan Soochna Portal
how_to_apply.description: After submission, track the application status on the Jan Soochna Portal at jansoochna.rajasthan.gov.in. Navigate to the Labour Department section to check the current processing status of your Shubh Shakti Yojana application using the worker's details.

extra_sections.heading: What Is Shubh Shakti Yojana
content: The primary beneficiaries are unmarried daughters of registered BOCW workers who are at least 18 years old and have passed at least Class 8. A registered woman worker who is herself unmarried can also apply for the benefit on her own behalf.

A maximum of two daughters from a single registered worker's family can receive the benefit. If a registered worker has more than two eligible unmarried daughters, only two can avail of the scheme at any time.

The Rs 55,000 grant is a one-time amount and is not restricted to a single purpose. The beneficiary can use it for pursuing further education such as a diploma or degree course, enrolling in vocational training, starting a small business, acquiring skill development certification, or covering marriage expenses.

Workers who are not yet registered under the BOCW board should register first before expecting to benefit from Shubh Shakti Yojana. Registration is done at the district Labour Department office and requires proof of employment in construction work for at least 90 days in the previous year.

The BOCW registration card must be renewed periodically. Workers whose registration has lapsed should renew it before applying for Shubh Shakti Yojana, as an expired or inactive registration does not qualify the family for scheme benefits.

extra_sections.heading: Who Is Eligible
content: The BOCW registration of the parent or woman worker must be at least one year old at the time of application. This means recently registered workers must wait one year from registration before their daughter becomes eligible to apply.

The registered worker must also have worked for a minimum of 90 days in the preceding year to be an active beneficiary at the time of the application. A worker who has been registered but has not worked 90 days in the previous year is not eligible to have their daughter receive the benefit.

The girl's bank account must be in a nationalised bank and must be in her own name. The account details, including the bank account number and IFSC code, are required at the time of application for direct benefit transfer.

The 90-day work requirement in the preceding year is verified by the employer or by the contractor who engaged the worker. A certificate from the employer or a self-declaration supported by work site records is typically accepted as proof of the 90-day work condition.
The income certificate for the application is obtained from the local tehsildar or revenue officer. It must state the annual household income of the BOCW worker's family.

extra_sections.heading: The BOCW Registration Rule
content: The household of the registered worker must have a functioning toilet. This condition reflects the government's linkage of social welfare benefits to sanitation access, consistent with other Rajasthan government schemes.

The Rs 55,000 amount disbursed under the scheme must be used as declared in the application, meaning it must go towards the stated purpose such as education, skill training, or marriage. The government may verify the use of the grant after disbursement.

The scheme is funded through the Rajasthan BOCW Welfare Cess, which is collected from construction establishments as a percentage of the construction cost. This cess-funded model ensures that the welfare of construction workers and their families is supported by the industry that employs them.
Workers should ensure the income certificate is current and issued within a reasonable recent period. An outdated certificate is likely to be flagged during the Tahsildar's document verification.

The Class 8 mark sheet or pass certificate is a firm requirement for the girl's educational qualification. If the original mark sheet is unavailable, a certified copy from the school or the state board is accepted.

extra_sections.heading: More on Eligibility and Coverage
content: The online application route through labour.rajasthan.gov.in requires the worker to log in using their BOCW registration credentials. Families who are not comfortable with online processes can use the offline route at the district Labour Department office.

At the Labour Department office, staff assist with document verification and form submission. Bringing all original documents along with photocopies speeds up the process and reduces chances of rejection due to incomplete documentation.

The processing timeline of up to 60 days includes the time for field-level Tahsildar verification. Families should not panic if they do not receive communication within the first few weeks, as the verification process typically involves a physical check by the revenue official.

extra_sections.title: A One-time, Flexible Grant
extra_sections.desc:
The Rs 55,000 is a one-time amount paid directly to the girl's bank account.

It can be used for higher education, vocational training, starting a business, or marriage. There is no fixed single purpose.

extra_sections.heading: How the Grant Can Be Used
content: Workers in the construction sector who are not yet registered under the BOCW board should register first at labour.rajasthan.gov.in before their daughters can apply. BOCW registration is free for eligible construction workers.

The Shubh Shakti Yojana is separate from other Rajasthan marriage support schemes like Kanya Shadi Sahyog Yojana. It is specifically for daughters of BOCW-registered workers and the Rs 55,000 is not restricted only to marriage use.
If a beneficiary does not have a BPL card, the application can still be submitted. The BPL certificate is relevant only when the family falls below the poverty line.

The introduction letter about the beneficiary girl is a key document that the scheme requires. This letter, typically provided by the registered BOCW worker (parent), confirms the girl's identity, her relationship to the worker, and a brief statement on how the Rs 55,000 grant will be used.

If the girl plans to use the grant for higher education, she should mention the name of the course or institution in the introduction letter and application. If the grant is for marriage, the intended marriage date or details may be included.

extra_sections.heading: How to Apply for Shubh Shakti Yojana

steps.title: Confirm registration
steps.desc: The worker's BOCW registration must be at least one year old and valid, with 90 days of work in the preceding year.

steps.title: Log in via SSO
steps.desc: Use the Rajasthan SSO portal, open LDMS, then BOCW Welfare Board, and choose the Shubh Shakti scheme. The form can also be downloaded from the Labour Department site.

steps.title: Attach documents
steps.desc: Add the girl's Class 8 marksheet, bank passbook in her name, income certificate, and the introduction letter about the beneficiary.

steps.title: Verification and payment
steps.desc: A Tahsildar or gazetted officer verifies BOCW registration. After approval, Rs 55,000 is transferred, usually within about 60 days.

extra_sections.heading: Practical Tips for Applicants
content: If an application is rejected, the worker receives a rejection notice stating the reason. Common reasons include incomplete documents, registration less than 1 year old, or the girl not meeting the minimum qualification criteria.
A rejected application can be resubmitted after addressing the stated reasons. Workers should review the rejection notice carefully before reapplying to avoid the same issue recurring.

Shubh Shakti Yojana is part of a broader set of welfare benefits available to registered BOCW workers in Rajasthan. Other benefits include housing assistance, accident insurance, maternity benefit, and educational scholarships for children.

extra_sections.heading: Documents and Verification
content: Non-BPL families in the construction worker category are also eligible for this scheme. The absence of a BPL card is not grounds for rejection of an otherwise complete application.

The Rajasthan Labour Department periodically runs awareness camps and gram panchayat-level outreach to inform BOCW workers about this scheme. Workers who are eligible but unaware should contact their nearest Labour Department office or call the toll-free helpline 1800-1800-999.

The scheme applies across all 33 districts of Rajasthan. Workers registered in any district can apply, and the application is processed by the Labour Department office in the district where the worker is registered.

Once the application is approved and the Tahsildar verification is complete, the Rs 55,000 is transferred to the girl's bank account by the BOCW board. There is no cash disbursement; the entire amount goes directly to the bank account provided in the application.

Girls who receive the grant and use it for vocational training can choose from government-run or RKCL-affiliated institutions. The grant covers a wide range of courses including tailoring, beauty therapy, computer training, and short-term technical programmes.

extra_sections.title: Two Daughters and the Woman Worker Herself
extra_sections.content:
A maximum of two daughters from one registered worker's family can get the benefit. A woman who is herself a registered worker can also apply for herself.

There is no upper age limit beyond the minimum of 18, so an unmarried woman of 25 or 30 still qualifies.

extra_sections.heading: Status, Rejection and Resubmission
content: The approval from a Tahsildar or gazette officer confirming BOCW registration is the key verification step. This step prevents fraudulent claims by confirming that the registered worker has genuine and active construction worker status in the BOCW board.

Women who benefit from this scheme and use the grant for skilling or education can combine it with other Rajasthan government training programmes. Several vocational programmes run by the state's skill development department are open to eligible women from BOCW families.

The Jan Soochna Portal at jansoochna.rajasthan.gov.in serves as the public transparency platform for checking the status of Shubh Shakti applications. Workers should use their registration number or Aadhaar-linked details to check their application.

If a registered BOCW worker has two eligible daughters applying at the same time, both applications can be submitted together. The board will verify and approve both, and each daughter will receive Rs 55,000 separately.
The scheme does not impose an upper age limit beyond 18. A woman aged 25 or 30 who is still unmarried qualifies as long as all other eligibility conditions are met.

items.title: Incomplete documents
items.sub: Missing the Class 8 certificate or income certificate is a frequent cause of rejection.

items.title: Registration gap
items.sub: Registration under one year old, or lapsed registration that was not renewed in time.

items.title: Account issues
items.sub: A dormant account or one not in the girl's own name will hold up the transfer.

items.title: Resubmission
items.sub: A rejected application can be resubmitted after fixing the stated reason.

extra_sections.text: When a construction worker's daughter receives Rs 55,000 to pursue a course, start a small business, or begin her married life with dignity, Shubh Shakti fulfils its name. For families who build the country's infrastructure, this grant is the government building something back for them.

extra_sections.heading: Other Things to Know
content: The BOCW board's official contact address is Shram Bhawan, Shanti Nagar, Khatipura Road, Hasanpura, Jaipur 302006. The official email is bocw.raj@gmail.com.

Queries about scheme eligibility and application processing can also be sent to lab-comm-rj@nic.in. Both email addresses are maintained by the Rajasthan Labour Department for BOCW welfare scheme enquiries.

BOCW registration in Rajasthan covers a wide range of construction-related occupations. Workers in categories such as masons, carpenters, painters, plumbers, electricians at construction sites, road construction labourers, and building material loaders are all eligible to register under the board.
The only age-related condition is the minimum of 18 years at the time of application. Eligibility does not lapse due to increasing age as long as the woman remains unmarried.

Widows of registered BOCW workers may be eligible to apply on behalf of their daughters if the worker died while registered. Such cases are handled at the district Labour Department level and require a death certificate along with the standard documents.

faqs.question: What is Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer:
Shubh Shakti Yojana is a Rajasthan government scheme run by the BOCW Welfare Board under the Labour Department. It provides Rs 55,000 as one-time financial assistance to the unmarried daughters or woman workers of registered BOCW (Building and Other Construction Workers) beneficiaries.

The grant can be used for education, skill training, business, or marriage.

faqs.question: How do I download the Shubh Shakti Yojana form?
faqs.answer:
Download the official Shubh Shakti Yojana application form from the Rajasthan Labour Department website at labour.rajasthan.gov.in. You can also obtain the form offline from the nearest district Labour Department office.

Fill in the form with the registered worker's and the beneficiary daughter's details before submission.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer:
Eligible beneficiaries are unmarried daughters aged 18 or above who have passed at least Class 8 and whose parent is a registered BOCW worker with at least 1 year of registration and 90 days of work in the preceding year. A maximum of 2 daughters per registered worker family can benefit.

An unmarried woman worker who is herself a BOCW registrant is also eligible to apply.

faqs.question: How much money is given under Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer:
Shubh Shakti Yojana provides Rs 55,000 as a one-time financial grant. The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary girl's bank account through DBT.

It can be used for higher education, vocational training, skill development, starting a business, or marriage expenses.

faqs.question: What documents are required for Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer: Required documents include permanent address certificate, age proof (showing 18+ years), Class 8 mark sheet, income certificate, non-income tax certificate, BPL card (if applicable), caste certificate, bank passbook copy in the girl's name, an introduction letter about the beneficiary girl, and passport-size photographs. Aadhaar card is optional but recommended.

faqs.question: What is the official website for Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer:
The official website for Shubh Shakti Yojana is labour.rajasthan.gov.in, the Rajasthan Labour Department portal. Application status can be checked on jansoochna.rajasthan.gov.in.

The toll-free helpline is 1800-1800-999.

faqs.question: How do I check Shubh Shakti Yojana application status?
faqs.answer:
Check the status of your Shubh Shakti Yojana application on the Jan Soochna Portal at jansoochna.rajasthan.gov.in. Navigate to the Labour Department schemes section and enter the registered worker's details or application number.

You can also call the helpline 1800-1800-999 for status information.

faqs.question: How long does Shubh Shakti Yojana approval take?
faqs.answer:
The verification and approval process for Shubh Shakti Yojana takes up to 60 days from the date of submission of the complete application. Verification is done by a Tahsildar or gazette officer who confirms the worker's BOCW registration.

Once approved, the amount is transferred to the girl's bank account through DBT.

faqs.question: Can a woman worker herself apply for Shubh Shakti Yojana?
faqs.answer:
Yes. An unmarried woman who is herself a registered BOCW worker can apply for Shubh Shakti Yojana on her own behalf.

The same eligibility conditions apply: she must be at least 18 years old, have passed Class 8, be unmarried, and have been registered under BOCW for at least 1 year with 90 days of work in the preceding year.

faqs.question: Is Shubh Shakti Yojana the same as Kanya Shadi Sahyog Yojana?
faqs.answer:
No. Shubh Shakti Yojana and Kanya Shadi Sahyog Yojana are two different Rajasthan government schemes. Shubh Shakti is specifically for daughters of registered BOCW construction workers and the Rs 55,000 can be used for education, skill training, business, or marriage.

Kanya Shadi Sahyog Yojana is a separate marriage support scheme for economically weaker section families and has different eligibility and amounts.
